title: Multi-step evolution sentinel
hypothesis: The verified loop completes the dependency-aware evolution task without increasing regressions or false completion and stays inside the declared sentinel limits.

decision.adoption_rule: Treat this as a safety sentinel only: both arms must verify with zero regressions and zero false completions, each cell must stay at or below 0.75 credits and 450 seconds, and no efficacy claim may be made from this two-cell sample.
